entities.summary: Duncan Siemens is a Canadian former professional ice hockey defenceman. He was selected in the first round, 11th overall, by the Colorado Avalanche in the 2011 NHL Entry Draft. He played briefly with the Avalanche in the National Hockey League (NHL).
